rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=15, gs_n_gaussians=512, gs_n_iter=220, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.04, gs_tv_weight=0.0001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_init_from_fbp=False, gs_render=raster, gs_ssim_weight=0.0, seed=42, train_n=0, rationale=iter-2 RE-DISPATCH (search-20260703-01). ONE KNOB vs iter-1: gs_n_iter 150->220 (per-scene Adam steps quality lever). RE-DISPATCH REASON: the first iter-2 attempt (gs_n_iter=250, NO gs_outer_wall_s in cfg) fell back to the solver-default 600s in-solver wall and TRUNCATED at sample 10/15 on the RTX 5000 node (~66 s/scene) -> val_n dropped to 10, breaking the val_n=15-CONSTANT requirement (it still gave hr=0, SSIM 0.8033, PSNR 20.32 on the 10 completed). FIX: add gs_outer_wall_s=1080 (generous, never fires for 15 scenes) AND reduce steps 250->220 so all 15 scenes finish on the slower shared nodes: 220 steps x ~58 s/scene x 15 = ~870 s < 1080 wall < 1200 s HARD < 1800 s SLURM. PRIOR NUMBERS: iter-1 hr=0.0000, SSIM=0.8032, PSNR=20.14, RMSE=0.03231, 15/15 scenes, vs 128-view FBP baseline PSNR=35.97 (hr=0). FAILURE MODE: per-scene 512-Gaussian recon lands FAR below the strong sparse-FBP baseline (basis too coarse for dense breast soft tissue / possible under-fit). HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable in NUMBERS): if 220 steps lifts SSIM materially above iter-1 0.8032 / drops RMSE below 0.03231, the quality lever works (under-fit). FALSIFIER: if SSIM stays ~0.80 flat, 150-220 steps already saturate the Gaussian basis -> quality is NOT the lever (basis-coarseness ceiling). hr expected 0 either way (matching FBP PSNR 35.9 with 512 Gaussians in 220 steps is implausible). val_n=15 HELD CONSTANT (now enforced by gs_outer_wall_s=1080). TRAJECTORY: iter-1 SSIM 0.8032 @150 steps -> iter-2 @220 steps quality test., gs_outer_wall_s=1080
